Our marketing strategy

How we market homes for sale in Northeast Pennsylvania.

Great photos get buyers to click. Selling for the right price takes more: a smart launch, the right exposure, careful follow-up and strong negotiation. Here's the full plan, start to finish.

01 Position02 Media03 Exposure04 Showings05 Negotiation

01 — Position

Priced and prepared before day one.

The first two weeks on the market matter most. We get the price and presentation right before your home goes live.

Pricing strategy

A recommendation built on recent sales near you and the homes you'll be competing with, explained clearly so you can decide with confidence. Nadine to confirm

Preparation advice

Practical, room-by-room guidance on what to fix, what to leave and how to present each space, so you only invest where it pays off. Nadine to confirm

02 — Media

Media that makes buyers stop scrolling.

Every listing launches with a full professional media package, produced specifically for your home.

Professional photography

Bright, magazine-quality photos that capture your home's light, space and character.

Cinematic video

A video tour that shows how your home flows and feels, before buyers ever step inside.

Zillow 3D home tours

Buyers can walk through every room from anywhere, so the people who book a showing already love the layout.

Floor plans

A clear, measured floor plan that helps buyers picture how they'd live in the space.

03 — Exposure

Seen everywhere buyers are looking.

Your media goes to work across the places local and relocating buyers actually search.

MLS & major real estate sites

Your listing in the local MLS and on the major home-search websites, presented with care everywhere it appears. Nadine to confirm

Social media

Your home shared with local buyers and the people who influence them, using the photos and video from your listing. Nadine to confirm

04 — Showings

Every showing handled for you.

We coordinate the details so your home is shown at its best, and you always know how it's being received.

Showing coordination

Showings scheduled around your life, with buyers' agents managed by our team. Nadine to confirm

Feedback & updates

Buyer feedback and market activity shared with you regularly, so you know what buyers are saying and why. Nadine to confirm

05 — Negotiation

From offer to the closing table.

The best offer isn't always the highest number. We help you weigh every term, then see it through.

Offer review & negotiation

Price, financing, contingencies and timing explained side by side, and negotiated on your behalf. Nadine to confirm

Under contract to closing

Inspections, appraisal, paperwork and deadlines tracked by our team, with clear updates until you hand over the keys. Nadine to confirm

Local knowledge

Marketing that speaks like a neighbor.

Buyers aren't only buying a house — they're buying a town, a school district, a commute and a way of life.

Because Nadine has spent her whole life in Northeast Pennsylvania, your listing can talk about the things buyers actually care about: the community events, the local businesses, the drive to Scranton, the quiet of the back roads. That's the difference between a listing that describes a house and one that sells a home.
